name: Conversation agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread)
description: Phase 3 skeleton golden set per conversation.spec.md §7. Covers the 8-class classifier plus 3 extracted signals (shippingAddress / proposedRateUsd / question) across 4 locales. The full 250-case-per-locale set lands in tests/golden/conversation/{ko,en,ja,zh-CN}.json during Phase 3 calibration.

metadata.note: Happy path — creator agrees and shares a US shipping address. Workflow proceeds to responder + shipment.create.
